defects.claim: The pool section can never be populated in production. SetPoolSource is called only in internal/briefs/structured_test.go:282, so `pool` is always null in stored briefs. The issue asks for pool "when the daemon knows it", but nothing in the daemon supplies it.
defects.evidence: Grep for SetPoolSource across *.go found only the definition and the test call.

defects.claim: The acceptance bullet "make test and make lint pass" is not met. The pasted `make lint` output ends with "3 issues", "staticcheck: 3" and "make: *** [Makefile:94: lint] Error 1". The `make test` output has 17523 lines omitted, so the PR body never shows it passing.

The receipts digest hides cost only for `platform`. The structured brief also hides it for `unknown` and empty, because it uses `== KeySourceOwn` at structured.go:78. The two paths disagree on the same rule.
If any row in the day ran on the platform key, the whole-day cost total is dropped, including the own-key spend. This is a behaviour choice the issue did not specify.
`FailedRun` has no title or PR field. The `ClassifyFailure` keyword matching is loose: "conflict", "eof" and "network" are matched as bare substrings.

The structured brief is stored only when `runBriefWithResults` runs, so it exists only when the daily brief is enabled. The receipts digest scheduler never writes one. The folding is also only partial: the receipts digest is still a separate Telegram message, and its output is not built from the `shipped` section.

The store assertion is done on the dashboard store. The issue says the routes should be "plain text", and the handlers return JSON. The routes do sit behind the shared `s.auth.Middleware(apiMux)` at server.go:291, which matches the sibling routes.
